strategies.authority: Owner-approved October 6 allocation replacement: broad core >=30%, individual total <=70%, no fixed single-name cap; source-bound company sizing. Existing tactical loss discipline and experimental status remain unchanged. October 7 owner-requested issuer-isolation repair preserves each failed issuer evidence gate and shared account/strategy limits; no experiment adoption or numerical threshold change. October 8 owner-requested two-session capital deployment escalation adds research/route prioritization and explanations; existing account, eligibility, allocation and risk limits remain authoritative. October 9 owner authorization makes private approved local-ledger records authoritative for conditional manual plans: record age/completeness and cash-estimate metadata no longer block research recommendations; known commitments, actual contradictions, economic and strategy limits remain effective. No broker facts or experimental results are changed. Shared publication-input registry repairs dashboard admission of the same approved local-record input; strategy thresholds and economic logic are unchanged. Current research projections also separate superseded historical account metadata requirements from genuine company and order evidence; immutable assessments remain retained. October 11 owner-requested passing-friction audit repairs research visibility and fund routing; accepted company reviews remain visible before numerical eligibility, funds cannot inherit stock sizing, and numerical thresholds, capital authority and experimental status are unchanged. Final artifact audit also distinguishes a current completed adverse company case from unfinished research; such a case remains zero-share NO_ACTION and cannot become eligible. Final dashboard audit keeps unadopted ETF routes out of closest-eligible routing and applies the same zero-share adverse-case rejection in the final capital adapter, including inconsistent upstream candidates. Final rendered explanation audit separates completed company rejection from unfinished research and labels retained evidence thresholds without implying removed fixed position-size tiers; numbers and eligibility are unchanged. October 12 owner explicitly requested full implementation and deployment of current source-bound company valuation into production. Individually versioned admissions override only their issuer comparator; invalid opted-in evidence stays issuer-local with no eligibility fallback. Current-price packet, decisions and email use the same immutable model. A current source-bound allocation plan and unchanged numerical gates remain required; no experiment adoption, risk-limit change or execution authority follows from model admission. Final company-model artifact verification keeps completed adverse cases visible without displacing unfinished company work or being labelled research-incomplete; no eligibility or quality threshold changes.
